Markets.title: Gaja Alternative Asset Management mobilises Rs 165 crore from anchor investors
Markets.summary: Gaja Alternative Asset Management raised Rs 165 crore from anchor investors ahead of its Rs 550 crore initial public offering opening on Wednesday. The IPO proceeds will be used for debt repayment, new fund seeding, and general corporate purposes, with shares listing on August 26.

Markets.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank raises $650 million in debut dollar bond sale
Markets.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank raised $650 million in its first-ever five-year dollar bond sale. Strong investor demand from Asia and Europe allowed the bank to lower its pricing and attract $2.1 billion in orders.

Markets.title: Sebi to soon float consultation paper on distribution framework for corporate bonds
Markets.summary: Sebi is preparing a consultation paper to refine the distribution framework and sales of corporate bonds. The initiative evaluates new distributor categories to broaden debt market participation and improve retail investor access to privately placed bonds.

Markets.title: Sakarni Plaster to invest Rs 450 cr on expansion; to set up 2 building material plants
Markets.summary: Sakarni Plaster plans to invest Rs 450 crore over the next two years to build two new manufacturing plants and expand existing facilities. The funds will be raised through internal accruals and bank loans to meet the growing demand for gypsum boards and paints.

Markets.title: US single-family housing starts slide in July
Markets.summary: U.S. single-family homebuilding declined in July due to high mortgage rates and a growing inventory of unsold houses. Despite this drop, permits for future single-family construction and overall residential permits increased slightly.

Markets.title: Keralam Govt to lease land to CSL for Rs 5,000 cr ship block building project, says CM Satheesan
Markets.summary: Kerala is leasing 18.16 acres of land to Cochin Shipyard for a Rs 5,000 crore ship block building project. This initiative will enhance the state's shipbuilding capabilities and create approximately 2,000 direct jobs.

Geo-Political.title: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
Geo-Political.summary: Russia has accused the UK of escalating the war in Ukraine by supplying British-made drones. In response, British Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated that the UK fully supports Kyiv.

Geo-Political.title: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
Geo-Political.summary: German authorities conducted their first raids under a new anti-smuggling law, seizing dinghies and life jackets from a secret warehouse. These operations target criminal gangs facilitating unauthorized small boat crossings into the country.

Geo-Political.title: Brazil's President Lula hails oil discovery near Amazon river
Geo-Political.summary: Brazilian President Lula has praised a new oil discovery in the sea near the mouth of the Amazon River. Environmentalists have strongly criticized the exploratory drilling that led to this find.

Geo-Political.title: Hayden Panettiere's ex Wladimir Klitschko says family in 'profound shock and grief'
Geo-Political.summary: Former heavyweight boxing champion Wladimir Klitschko stated that his family is in profound shock and grief following the death of his former partner, actress Hayden Panettiere. Panettiere, with whom he shares a child, passed away on Sunday.

Geo-Political.title: Kariba ferry death toll rises to 93, making it Zimbabwe's deadliest transport disaster
Geo-Political.summary: The death toll from a ferry disaster on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe has risen to 93 victims. This incident is now recorded as the deadliest transport disaster in the country's history, while recovery efforts remain ongoing.

Geo-Political.title: Pakistan top court orders ex-PM Imran Khan be moved to hospital from jail
Geo-Political.summary: Pakistan's Supreme Court has ordered that imprisoned former Prime Minister Imran Khan be transferred from jail to a hospital. Khan has been serving time since 2023 on corruption charges that he claims are politically motivated.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator found their WordPress SaaS course recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for product suggestions. The author achieved this recommendation without using paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide explains how to use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money online. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) has increased India's GDP growth forecast for the 2026-27 financial year to 6.8%. However, ongoing risks like the West Asia conflict, high inflation, and currency depreciation could negatively impact this outlook.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is accelerating agricultural spending and fertilizer subsidies to protect rural incomes. This strategy aims to counteract the negative economic impacts of El Niño and a weak monsoon on the rural economy.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research projects a $50 billion surplus in India's balance of payments for the 2027 fiscal year. This financial milestone is expected to be driven by strong foreign currency inflows.

Data & Insights.title: Patchy progress, masked extremes: how the Southwest Monsoon has played out so far
Data & Insights.summary: Although the cumulative rainfall deficit for the Southwest Monsoon has narrowed to 13%, the season has been marked by erratic swings between intense downpours and long dry spells. These extremes have created severe regional imbalances across the country.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighs scrapping performance bank guarantees for MSME contracts
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is considering the removal of performance bank guarantees for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) awarded government contracts. This change could significantly impact MSMEs, which accounted for half of the central government's ₹2.30 trillion procurement in fiscal year 2026.

Data & Insights.title: India’s overall unemployment rate falls in July; joblessness rises in urban centres but eases in rural areas
Data & Insights.summary: According to the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS), India's overall unemployment rate fell in July. While joblessness eased in rural areas, it rose in urban centers.

India.title: Satyendar Jain Arrest: Case Will Be Proven Fake, Says Arvind Kejriwal
India.summary: Former Delhi minister Satyendar Jain was arrested in connection with a money laundering case involving alleged tender manipulation at the Delhi Jal Board. Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal responded to the arrest by stating that the case will be proven fake.

India.title: 'Tarun Tejpal Punishment Inadequate': Goa's 'Life Term' Plea In Supreme Court
India.summary: Goa has appealed to the Supreme Court, arguing that the 10-year prison sentence given to former journalist Tarun Tejpal for a 2013 rape is inadequate and should be increased to a life term. The Bombay High Court's Goa Bench had previously overturned Tejpal's 2021 acquittal and convicted him for raping a colleague inside an elevator.

India.title: AAP Leader Satyendar Jain Arrested In Corruption Case Linked To Delhi Jal Board
India.summary: Anti-Corruption Bureau officials arrested Aam Aadmi Party leader Satyendar Jain regarding a corruption case involving the Delhi Jal Board. Jain had previously spent several months in jail for a money laundering case before receiving bail in 2024.

India.title: Non-Bailable Warrant Issued Against Pakistan-Based Terrorist In Jammu
India.summary: A non-bailable warrant has been issued in Jammu against Pakistan-based terrorist Abu Sumama. He is accused of directing attacks on security forces and targeted killings of civilians in Kashmir.

India.title: Belonging - A Journey Of Love: Sonia Gandhi's Memoir Out On November 10
India.summary: Publisher Alfred A. Knopf announced that Sonia Gandhi's memoir, "Belonging: A Journey of Love," will be released on November 10. The book chronicles the personal and political life of the prominent Indian politician.

India.title: In Numbers: From Classrooms To Jobs, Jharkhand's Youth Struggle
India.summary: Student leader Devendra Nath Mahto ended his 16-day hunger strike following a decision by the government. The protest was related to ongoing struggles faced by the youth of Jharkhand regarding education and employment.

General.title: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
General.summary: Russia accused the UK of escalating the war in Ukraine by supplying British-made drones. Despite this warning, the British prime minister vowed 100% support for Kyiv.

General.title: British couple on honeymoon killed in helicopter crash on Greek island
General.summary: A British couple on their honeymoon was killed in a helicopter crash on a Greek island. The Greek pilot of the aircraft also died in the accident.

General.title: PM says he's not embarrassed about hoax message exchange
General.summary: The Prime Minister communicated with someone who was falsely pretending to be Donald Trump's chief of staff, Susie Wiles. He stated that he is not embarrassed about the hoax message exchange.

General.title: How soon will the drought be over?
General.summary: Recent rain has returned to parts of the UK this week. It remains uncertain whether this rainfall is enough to end the drought in affected regions.

General.title: National Television Awards pick first all-female shortlist for drama acting award
General.summary: The National Television Awards have announced their first-ever all-female shortlist for the drama acting category. The five nominees are Ella Bruccoleri, Sheridan Smith, Ruth Jones, Vicky McClure, and Judy Parfitt.
